title: Nitrous Oxide On Acute Postoperative Pain and Opioid Consumption and Chronic Pain After Inguinal Hernia Repair Surgery
brief_summary: To compare postoperative pain, opioid consumption and chronic pain in patients undergoing to hernia repair surgery after receiving nitrous oxide or oxygen during the general anesthesia.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 18 to 65 years old at time of the first procedure
* American Society of Anesthesiologists physical status I or II
* Inguinal hernia repair surgery undergoing the general anesthesia

Exclusion Criteria:

* Neuropathic disease
* Chronic opioid users
* Contraindication for Nitrous Oxide receive
* Consent will not be obtained patient
* Psychiatric disorders
* Current or recent drug abuse (within past 6 months).
